verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken symptom list: items run together ('Shortness of breath Dry / cough', 'Sore throat Headache'), so 6 symptoms read as 4 garbled lines and 'cough' is orphaned. Both also shrink the full-width yellow hashtag bar into a small badge and crop the doctor illustration on both sides. B's badge sits on the same left edge as the headline and list, so it aligns slightly better; A's centred badge floats off that left axis.
